reply.text:
I can't give you a safe-to-mix answer, and I won't put an amount on pre-workout. Both are things your body has to process, and pre-workouts are mostly stimulants like caffeine. Stimulants can make it harder to tell how much alcohol you've had, and both can dehydrate you and raise your heart rate, so training on top of that is a poor combination in general terms.

For whether it's okay for you specifically, ask a doctor or pharmacist, especially if you take any medication or have a heart or blood pressure issue. If it's about timing around a session, my usual approach is to keep training and drinking well apart. I'm glad to help you plan the training side.
